title: The Little Engines that Could've: The Calculating Machines of Charles Babbage
version: Harvard University PhD thesis, August 1970. Trinity College Dublin PDF compilation of the online edition.
lineage: Collier reconstructs the design chronology from original Babbage notebooks and drawings. His citation of the earlier notebook entry is a separate documentary basis from the 1839 letter to Arago and the published description Menabrea produced after Babbage’s Turin visit.

passages.locator: Chapter 3, chapter PDF pp. 5 and 18 (whole PDF pp. 27 and 40), especially nn. 31, 41–42
passages.note: Traces how an earlier design used a studded control drum and says that Babbage directly adapted Jacquard loom control when he adopted cards. Collier cites Scribbling Book II p. 146, cross-referencing vol. I p. 160. The original notebooks were not available for direct inspection in this research pass.
